title: Friends working on antigravity received threats

tellings.quote: You mentioned on Danny Jones that several of your friends worked on antigravity and received a kind of backlash,

plain: Several friends of a scientist named Kevin Knuth worked on antigravity, meaning technology that would cancel or push against gravity, and they are said to have faced backlash and threats for it. Michels raises this with Knuth, who appears on the show as a NASA whistleblower. Michels reminds him that he first told the story on Danny Jones's podcast. If true, it would suggest that this kind of research is actively discouraged.
